dialogues.speaker: Gurevikov
dialogues.text: Passengers, please keep moving in order and make room behind you! Let passengers off before boarding, and mind your safety! ...Is something the matter, passenger?

dialogues.speaker: Gurevikov
dialogues.text: Of course. This is Snezhnograd Central Station, after all. No small number of people pass through here every day...

dialogues.speaker: Gurevikov
dialogues.text: That is why the platforms are always especially crowded during boarding and disembarking, and why minor accidents are most likely to happen here... So please proceed with caution.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if someone pushes through the platform...?

dialogues.speaker: Gurevikov
dialogues.text: If it's a relatively urgent situation, we can tolerate. If not... you will be escorted to Transport Bureau headquarters for disrupting public order...

dialogues.speaker: Gurevikov
dialogues.text: And you will likely have to pay a fine just large enough to... teach you a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Gurevikov
dialogues.text: Very well. Please take care, passenger.
